items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: It’s an Al Cohn tune with Osie Johnson on drums I think. No it’s Osie Johnson’s tune.

ctx.x: Oh, I know exactly what that is. It’s an Al Cohn tune with Osie Johnson on drums I think. No it’s Osie Johnson’s tune. Oh God I’m coming up on everything but the right one.
Well do you recognize the trumpet player?
